activity.summary: Mentions, replies, unreads, and notification levels
activity.toolGuidance: Read activity; results are bounded. mute/unmute/volume change the owner's notification settings: change them only on request. volume base [medium|soft|hush] shows or sets the app-wide level (Settings → Notifications); chats with their own level ignore it.

browser.summary: Hosted-browser sharing and secure form handoff
browser.toolGuidance: Use a session_id from browser_session_create, never a viewer URL; handoff --fields accepts a JSON array of snapshot refs or exact name/label selectors, never field values. No credential or recipient overrides.

buckets.toolGuidance: Use for Bucket files, not generic uploads; current ship permissions apply.

channels.toolGuidance: Manage chat, heap, and notes channels; join/leave affects one channel, not the whole workspace.

contacts.toolGuidance: Read contacts and update the current ship profile.

dms.toolGuidance: Use message for sending/replying; other DM operations remain available.

expose.toolGuidance: Changes public visibility; expose only content requested by the user.

groups.summary: Workspaces (Tlon groups), roles, membership, and channel sections
groups.toolGuidance: Use create-owned when creating a group for a user. Organize channels with the section commands; read ids from groups info first.

hooks.toolGuidance: Advanced channel hooks; inspect help and the hook reference first.

messages.toolGuidance: Read history; send ordinary messages through message.

notes.toolGuidance: Use workspace files; note-publish makes a note public as the owner, so publish only on request; owner-confirmed migration writes are unavailable.

posts.summary: Post reactions, edits, deletes, and pins
posts.toolGuidance: Send/reply through message; `posts edit` parses ~ship, @role-id and @all like a send but notifies nobody; do not manage deprecated diary posts.

settings.toolGuidance: Read or change explicitly requested settings.

upload.toolGuidance: Use a URL or workspace file; stdin is shell-only.
